auditIntake.title: Estate Watch — audit intake
auditIntake.subtitle: Freeze the claimant's planting claim, import block boundaries, and run plausibility checks before Phase 2 satellite monitoring.
auditIntake.epistemicNote: Labels used here are CLAIM (declared), OBSERVATION (measured), and ESTIMATION (inferred) — never verified or fraud.
auditIntake.loadError: Could not load audit intake. Ensure this is an Estate & Forest Watch project.
auditIntake.claimLabel: CLAIM — as declared by the project proponent
auditIntake.noSnapshots: No frozen snapshots yet — save the claim, then freeze a snapshot.
auditIntake.noBoundaries: No boundaries yet — import KML or draw on the work-area map.
auditIntake.documentsHint: Upload work orders, planting certificates, tenure references, or third-party audit reports.
auditIntake.validationBoundariesRequired: Import at least one block boundary before running plausibility review.
auditIntake.noPlausibilityResults: No plausibility results yet — run the review after boundaries are imported.
auditIntake.exclusionsHint: Draw roads, buildings, or water bodies that should be excluded from planting area calculations.

auditRoadmap.title: Estate Watch audit pipeline
auditRoadmap.subtitle: Work through each phase on this page — later steps unlock after the previous action succeeds.

field.title: Field verification
field.action: Record visits on web or Field ops

auditSatellite.title: Satellite & temporal analysis
auditSatellite.subtitle: Establish T0 baseline at planting date, build T0–T4 vegetation timeline, and prepare for confidence mapping.
auditSatellite.auditModeNote: Audit mode: stub satellite providers are rejected — only live Sentinel-2 observations are stored.
auditSatellite.intakeRequired: Complete audit intake before starting satellite analysis.
auditSatellite.nextStepHint: When every plot has a T0 baseline and timeline, click Mark analysis ready above to unlock the confidence map and risk engine below.
auditSatellite.analysisReadySuccess: Analysis marked ready — confidence map and risk engine are now unlocked.
auditSatellite.noBlocks: No blocks — import boundaries during intake first.
auditSatellite.epistemicNote: All values are OBSERVATION (measured) — not verified plantation claims.

auditConfidence.title: Plantation confidence map
auditConfidence.subtitle: Fuse plausibility, GIS, T0 baseline, and temporal NDVI into per-block confidence grades.
auditConfidence.epistemicNote: Grades are ESTIMATION — plausible, uncertain, inconsistent, or no data. Never verified or fraud.
auditConfidence.analysisRequired: Complete satellite analysis (mark analysis ready) before computing the confidence map.
auditConfidence.noBlocks: No assessments yet — compute the confidence map.

auditAttestation.title: Auditor review & attestation
auditAttestation.subtitle: Review anomaly dispositions and sign an independent attestation on the exported audit pack.
auditAttestation.epistemicNote: Attestations are ATTESTATION — reviewer judgement, not automated fraud findings.
auditAttestation.exportRequired: Generate the signed audit export before starting reviewer attestation.
auditAttestation.leadSignHint: Lead auditor signs first. A second reviewer must co-sign before the engagement is marked attested.
auditAttestation.cosignHint: Confirm you have reviewed the export pack and agree with the lead auditor verdict.

auditIntegrityBridge.title: Integrity bridge
auditIntegrityBridge.subtitle: Align per-tree integrity fusion gates with Estate Watch export readiness.
auditIntegrityBridge.epistemicNote: Fusion scores are ESTIMATION — use them to prioritise remediation before attestation.

auditReaudit.title: Continuous re-audit
auditReaudit.subtitle: Start a new monitoring cycle after attestation while preserving prior cycle history.
auditReaudit.epistemicNote: Re-audit resets field plots and clears attestation — prior cycles remain verifiable via archived hashes.
auditReaudit.historyEmpty: No prior cycles — this is the first attestation period.
auditReaudit.startHint: Archive the current attestation, reset plot visits, and return to satellite analysis for the next monitoring period.
auditReaudit.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Annual re-verification after monsoon season
auditReaudit.attestedRequired: Complete attestation before starting a new re-audit cycle.

auditReconciliation.title: Confidence vs field reconciliation
auditReconciliation.subtitle: Compare satellite-derived confidence grades with on-ground field visit outcomes per block.
auditReconciliation.fieldRequired: Generate a sampling plan and record field visits to see reconciliation.

auditExport.title: Evidence room & audit export
auditExport.subtitle: Download a signed zip bundle with intake, satellite, confidence, risk, and field verification artefacts.
auditExport.epistemicNote: Signed export supports audit preparation — not certification or fraud findings.
auditExport.notReady: Complete earlier audit phases before exporting.
auditExport.fieldVisitsRequired: Record field visits and mark field verification complete before exporting.
auditExport.reconciliationOk: All {count} reconciled block(s) align between satellite confidence and field visits.
auditExport.reconciliationWarning: Reconciliation: {mismatch} mismatch(es) and {noField} block(s) without field data. Review before attestation.
